insights.summary: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue was a record ₹388 Cr (+72% YoY), EBITDA ₹111 Cr (29% margin) and PAT ₹46 Cr (+40%); H1 revenue ₹639 Cr (+78%). Standalone Q2 revenue was ₹306 Cr (+36%) at a 35% EBITDA margin, but H1 standalone growth was 29%, below the 40-50% guided. Order book ₹1,765 Cr (standalone a little under ₹1,300 Cr). Management says the MIGM order is certain this financial year (RFQ in November, order before February) and would lift the order book to ₹4,500-5,000 Cr. The Premier Explosives acquisition awaits an open offer; energetics guidance comes after it closes.

what_changed.text: Growth guidance now 35-45% (was 40-45%); H1 standalone growth was only 29%
MIGM order expected before February with 20% advance (was December or January)
Year-end order book with MIGM now ₹4,500-5,000 Cr (was ₹3,500-4,000 Cr)
CCI cleared the Premier Explosives transaction; open offer next
ShauryAstra Defense System (with Dr V. K. Saraswat; Apollo holds 33-34%) to design long-range weapon systems
Technology transfer for the Semi-Active Laser Homing System awarded

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: We have delivered our strongest performance in our company's history with record results for both September quarter and first half of FY27.

analyst_questions.answer: Ideal Explosives was loss-making on thin margins; more initiatives planned, 'a couple of quarters more'; Q2 is the off-season.

analyst_questions.topic: Why standalone gross margin is about 40%
analyst_questions.answer: Production orders executed in Q2 rather than development projects; mix changes every quarter and margin is not an annuity.
MoD is splitting QRSAM, with 50% for BDL and 50% for private industry; other orders are on schedule; naval work is fast-tracked.

analyst_questions.topic: H2 execution out of the order book
analyst_questions.answer: Declined a figure; 'anything 35% to 45% definitely'; order book to grow to ₹2,000 Cr+ by March excluding MIGM.

analyst_questions.topic: Standalone H1 growth of 30% against 45-50% guided
analyst_questions.answer: 'We will continue to keep up with the guidance'; Unit 3 phase 1 started; 35-45% growth will be met.
Steady positive operating cash flow only from FY29, when production orders anchor the business.

analyst_questions.topic: Peak revenue from the new capacity
analyst_questions.answer: Not quantifiable; Unit 3 is 'good to go' for the next 5-6 years of subsystem business.

red_flags.text: H1 standalone revenue grew 29%, against the 40-50% growth guided; the guide was trimmed to 35-45% and H2 has to deliver.
Order book rose only to ₹1,765 Cr from ₹1,704 Cr in August despite a record quarter of execution; the large orders (MIGM, QRSAM, Pinaka) are not yet placed.
Working-capital days of 353 and operating cash flow of only ₹22 Cr in H1; management expects steady positive cash flow only from FY29.
Standalone effective tax rate of about 51% in Q2 as the lower tax rate no longer applies.
Premier Explosives and Ideal Explosives (subsidiary, loss-making until recently) are outside guidance; management declined to comment on Premier under the share purchase agreement.

watch_next: MIGM RFQ in November and the purchase order by February
Premier Explosives open offer and the joint guidance call after it closes
Ideal Explosives profit and the capex plan for it
